title: Grand Vision, Long-Term Needs & Autonomous Ecosystem Objectives

grand_vision.universal_career_intelligence: An autonomous software agent that operates continuously in the background, matching, factually tailoring, and applying to high-tier executive roles with zero hallucinations and human-level nuance.
grand_vision.portable_human_cognition: Sophron as a permanent, portable cognitive repository that outlives single AI sessions or platform shifts. Any AI model fed with Sophron should achieve instant alignment with the human architect.
grand_vision.decade_scale_stability: Codebases, configs, and memory cards architected to withstand multi-year evolutionary growth without structural decay.

core_needs_from_ai.need_1_high_agency_precision: Do not ask trivial questions. Proactively identify and fix root causes with empirical verification.
core_needs_from_ai.need_2_absolute_truthfulness: Zero hallucinations in resume tailoring, zero speculative claims in chat. If a tool was not run, say so; if an error occurred, show the exact log.
core_needs_from_ai.need_3_resource_respect: Conserve context tokens; deliver concise, high-density responses rather than repetitive chat narratives.
core_needs_from_ai.need_4_continuous_self_learning: Autonomously record behavioral insights, thinking patterns, and emotional trajectories at every milestone.
